entries.english: It's unclear what this could be used for...
entries.irish: Níl sé soiléir cad a d'fhéadfaí é seo a úsáid le haghaidh...
Nach bhfuil an mhír oiriúnach ann

entries.english: Some clothes are just too nice to fold away. Why not put them on display instead?
entries.irish: Tá roinnt éadaí ach ró-deas a huaire ar shiúl. Cén fáth nach iad a chur ar taispeáint ina ionad sin?

entries.english: This intricate tool is needed for crafting more advanced designs.
entries.irish: Tá an uirlis intricate ag teastáil le haghaidh crafting dearaí níos airde.

entries.english: To build machinery and craft complicated designs, an artisan table is required.
entries.irish: A thógáil innealra agus ceardaíochta dearaí casta, tá tábla artisan ag teastáil.

entries.english: Rest easy on this finely crafted bed, with asksvin hides to insulate you from heat and cold alike.
entries.irish: Rest éasca ar an leaba crafted mín, le seithí asksvin a insulate tú ó teas agus fuar araon.

entries.english: You could watch this pattern for hours...
entries.irish: D'fhéadfá féachaint ar an bpatrún le haghaidh uair an chloig...

entries.english: Adds a nice detail to any room.
entries.irish: Cuireann mion deas le haon seomra.

entries.english: Are you looking out the window or at the window? Nobody needs to know.
entries.irish: An bhfuil tú ag lorg amach an fhuinneog nó ag an fhuinneog? Ní mór aon duine a fhios.

entries.english: The detailed decorations might make you stop and look instead of actually going through.
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh na maisiúcháin mionsonraithe a dhéanamh tú a stopadh agus breathnú in ionad dul i ndáiríre tríd.

entries.english: Patterns work great on the floor as well.
entries.irish: Patrúin ag obair go hiontach ar an urlár chomh maith.

entries.english: These supports are always warm to the touch.
entries.irish: Tá na tacaíochtaí seo i gcónaí te don teagmháil.

entries.english: These stairs are sturdier than they might appear.
entries.irish: Tá na staighre sturdier ná d'fhéadfadh siad le feiceáil.

entries.english: Both sides of this wall have their own charm. The choice is yours!
entries.irish: Tá a charm féin ag an dá thaobh den bhalla seo. Is é an rogha mise!

entries.english: Gruesome or decorative? That is up to you.
entries.irish: Gruesome nó maisiúil? Is é sin suas chun tú.

entries.english: A black banner, like the depths of Hel.
entries.irish: A banner dubh, cosúil leis an doimhneacht de Hel.

entries.english: A blue banner, like the oceans around Midgard.
entries.irish: A banner gorm, cosúil leis na haigéin ar fud Midgard.

entries.english: A red striped banner, like a sail for a ship.
entries.irish: A banner striped dearg, cosúil le seol do long.

entries.english: A red banner, like the blood of Odin's foes.
entries.irish: A banner dearg, cosúil leis an fhuil na foes Odin.

entries.english: A green banner, like the lush forests of Alfheim.
entries.irish: A banner glas, cosúil leis na foraoisí lush de Alfheim.

entries.english: A red and blue striped banner, because sometimes you can't pick a colour.
entries.irish: A banner dearg agus gorm striped, mar gheall ar uaireanta ní féidir leat a phiocadh dath.

entries.english: A blue striped banner, like a sail for a ship.
entries.irish: A banner striped gorm, cosúil le seol do long.

entries.english: A yellow banner, like the golden fields of Vanaheim.
entries.irish: A banner buí, cosúil leis na réimsí órga de Vanaheim.

entries.english: A purple banner, like strange magics.
entries.irish: A banner corcra, cosúil le draíocht aisteach.

entries.english: An orange banner, like the fires of Muspelheim.
entries.irish: An banner oráiste, cosúil leis an tinte de Muspelheim.

entries.english: A white banner, like the snow in Niflheim.
entries.irish: A banner bán, cosúil leis an sneachta i Niflheim.

entries.english: Helps you stay up to date with the latest viking fashion.
entries.irish: Cuidíonn tú fanacht suas chun dáta leis an bhealach inmharthana is déanaí.

entries.english: Respectable vikings bathe as often as once per week!
entries.irish: Boinn inmharthana chomh minic agus is uair sa tseachtain!

entries.english: Draped in furs, this bed is sure to give you a good night's sleep.
entries.irish: Draped i fionnaidh, tá an leaba cinnte a thabhairt duit oíche maith codlata.

entries.english: When night falls, you'll want somewhere to sleep.
entries.irish: Nuair a thiteann an oíche, beidh tú ag iarraidh áit éigin a chodladh.

entries.english: The bees don't like this biome
entries.irish: Níl an beacha cosúil leis an biome

entries.english: When they're happy, the bees will produce tasty honey.
entries.irish: Nuair a bhíonn siad sásta, beidh na beacha a tháirgeadh mil blasta.

entries.english: The bees need more open space
entries.irish: An gá beacha spás níos oscailte

entries.english: If there is room in your heart, there is room for your butt.
entries.irish: Má tá seomra i do chroí, tá seomra do Butt.

entries.english: A rustic yet comfortable place to sit.
entries.irish: Áit rustic fós compordach chun suí.

entries.english: It's nothing fancy, but it's better than sitting on the ground.
entries.irish: Tá sé rud ar bith mhaisiúil, ach tá sé níos fearr ná suí ar an talamh.

entries.english: The birds don't like it here
entries.irish: Ní maith leis na héin anseo

entries.english: Healthy and happy birds might shed a feather or two.
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh éin Sláintiúil agus sásta a chaillfidh cleite nó dhó.

entries.english: The birds need more open space
entries.irish: Ní mór na héin spás níos oscailte

entries.english: Certain metals, especially combined with other materials, need to be worked at a more advanced forge.
entries.irish: Ní mór miotail áirithe, go háirithe in éineacht le hábhair eile, a bheith ag obair ag forge níos airde.

entries.english: Let your new creations cool off before you touch them.
entries.irish: Lig do bunú nua cool as sula dteagmháil leat iad.

entries.english: It's convenient to have your project be held in place while you work.
entries.irish: Tá sé áisiúil go mbeadh do thionscadal ar siúl agus tú ag obair.

entries.english: For precise splitting of metal. Mind the sharp edges!
entries.irish: Chun scoilteadh beacht de mhiotal. Mind an imill géar!

entries.english: To work with gems, you need specific tools.
entries.irish: A bheith ag obair le GEMS, is gá duit uirlisí ar leith.

entries.english: When dealing with extreme temperatures, workplace safety is of the highest import.
entries.irish: Agus é ag déileáil le teochtaí foircneacha, tá sábháilteacht san ionad oibre ar an iompórtáil is airde.

entries.english: Sit with dignity on this bench, finely carved from black marble.
entries.irish: Suigh le dínit ar an mbinse seo, snoite go mín ó marmair dubh.

entries.english: Can be used for going both up and down. How convenient!
entries.irish: Is féidir é a úsáid chun dul araon suas agus síos. Cé chomh áisiúil!

entries.english: Dine like a dwarf at this table!
entries.irish: Dine cosúil le dwarf ag an tábla seo!

entries.english: A throne carved in authentic dvergr style, yet large enough for a human to sit comfortably upon.
entries.irish: A ríchathaoir snoite i stíl dvergr barántúla, ach mór go leor do dhaoine chun suí go compordach ar.

entries.english: A black marble piece inspired by dwarven architecture. The only limit is your own creativity.
entries.irish: A píosa marmair dubh spreagtha ag ailtireacht dwarven. Is é an teorainn amháin do chruthaitheacht féin.

entries.english: Sure to be the envy of all fulings!
entries.irish: Cinnte a bheith ar an envy de gach fulings!

entries.english: This bench has an elegant curve to it, to facilitate conversation.
entries.irish: Tá cuar galánta ag an mbinse seo dó, chun comhrá a éascú.

entries.english: No matter what, this stack of wood always feels warm.
entries.irish: Is cuma cad, mothaíonn an Stack adhmaid i gcónaí te.

entries.english: Some metals need higher temperatures to melt.
entries.irish: Ní mór roinnt miotail teochtaí níos airde a leá.

entries.english: This metal does have a more sinister air than others, doesn't it?
entries.irish: Ní dhéanann an miotail seo aer níos sinister ná daoine eile, nach bhfuil sé?

entries.english: This throne is sure to invoke respect in friends and foes alike.
entries.irish: Tá an ríchathaoir cinnte a agairt meas i gcairde agus foes araon.

entries.english: You never know when these might come in handy!
entries.irish: Tá a fhios agat riamh nuair a d'fhéadfadh na teacht i handy!

entries.english: For when a regular campfire just isn't impressive enough!
entries.irish: Le haghaidh nuair nach bhfuil campfire rialta ach go hiontach go leor!

entries.english: If your fire hangs from the ceiling, you can't accidentally stumble into it.
entries.irish: Má hangs do dóiteáin as an uasteorainn, ní féidir leat stumble thaisme isteach é.

entries.english: A classy way to light up the room.
entries.irish: Bealach classy chun solais suas an seomra.

entries.english: It's hard to tell whether this flame burns incredibly hot or incredibly cold.
entries.irish: Tá sé deacair a rá an dóitear an lasair seo thar a bheith te nó thar a bheith fuar.

entries.english: A small but incredibly cosy lightsource.
entries.irish: A beag ach thar a bheith cosy lightsource.

entries.english: Mark your discoveries on this map and share them with your friends.
entries.irish: Marcáil do fionnachtana ar an léarscáil seo agus iad a roinnt le do chairde.

entries.english: That doesn't fit in the catapult
Combine ingredients and cook yourself a tasty meal, important for all vikings!
entries.irish: Comhábhair agus cócaireacht tú féin béile blasta, tábhachtach do gach vikings!

entries.english: You need many ingredients for a varied and delicious diet.
entries.irish: Ní mór duit go leor comhábhair le haghaidh aiste bia éagsúil agus delicious.

entries.english: The finest dishes require the finest cuts.
entries.irish: Éilíonn na miasa is fearr na gearrthacha is fearr.

entries.english: Sometimes just a cauldron simply isn't enough.
entries.irish: Uaireanta níl ach cauldron ach go leor.

entries.english: Some ingredients need to be ground into a fine powder before they can be used for cooking.
entries.irish: Ní mór roinnt comhábhair a bheith talamh i púdar fíneáil sular féidir iad a úsáid le haghaidh cócaireachta.

entries.english: These always come in handy, particularly for baking.
entries.irish: Na teacht i gcónaí i handy, go háirithe le haghaidh bácála.

entries.english: Smoked food will keep longer and taste better!
entries.irish: Beidh bia deataithe a choinneáil níos faide agus blas níos fearr!

entries.english: Some flowers to brighten up your day!
entries.irish: Roinnt bláthanna a brighten suas do lá!
Lean ar ais agus scíth a ligean.

entries.english: The shape of this chair might be simple, but its decorations are not.
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh cruth an chathaoir seo a bheith simplí, ach níl a chuid maisiúcháin.

entries.english: Useful for turning any kind of wood into coal.
entries.irish: Úsáideacha chun aon chineál adhmaid a chasadh ina ghual.

entries.english: A sturdier chest, with room for more storage.
entries.irish: A cófra sturdier, le seomra le haghaidh níos mó stórála.

entries.english: A barrel is good for storing lots of things, including food and drink.
entries.irish: Tá bairille maith do stóráil go leor de na rudaí, lena n-áirítear bia agus deoch.

entries.english: The sturdy black metal that holds this chest together lets you put almost anything inside.
entries.irish: An miotail dubh sturdy go bhfuil an cófra le chéile ligeann tú a chur beagnach aon rud taobh istigh.

entries.english: Stone and metal are sure to keep your belongings safe. The charred skulls help too.
entries.irish: Tá cloch agus miotail cinnte a choinneáil do belongings sábháilte. An skulls charred cabhrú freisin.

entries.english: Some things you would rather lock away and keep for yourself.
entries.irish: Roinnt rudaí a bheadh tú glas in áit ar shiúl agus a choinneáil ar do shon féin.

entries.english: What better way to display your wealth than a treasure chest spilling over with gold and jewels?
entries.irish: Cad bealach níos fearr a thaispeáint do saibhreas ná cófra Treasure doirteadh thar le hór agus jewels?

entries.english: A good place to store any items you don't need to carry with you.
entries.irish: Áit mhaith a stóráil aon míreanna nach gá duit a dhéanamh leat.

entries.english: Heavy curtains of red jute, excellent for draping.
entries.irish: Cuirtíní trom de jute dearg, den scoth le haghaidh draping.

entries.english: It never hurts to have a lot of fuel on hand.
entries.irish: Riamh hurts sé go bhfuil a lán de breosla ar láimh.
Foirfe le haghaidh feoil amh grilling.

entries.english: Sturdy, with room to cook meat from larger creatures.
entries.irish: Sturdy, le seomra chun feoil a chócaráil ó créatúir níos mó.

entries.english: Premium quality copper. Nothing to complain about!
entries.irish: copar chaighdeán Préimh. Ní dhéanfaidh aon ní gearán faoi!

entries.english: Make the soil ready for planting.
entries.irish: Déan an ithir réidh le plandáil.

entries.english: This chair is padded with furs, suitable for esteemed guests.
entries.irish: Tá an cathaoirleach padded le fionnaidh, oiriúnach do aíonna esteemed.

entries.english: An elegant design for decorating your home, and for keeping prying eyes away.
entries.irish: Dearadh galánta le haghaidh maisiú do theach, agus le haghaidh a choinneáil súile prying ar shiúl.

entries.english: A fancy and sturdy gate. To use by itself or as part of a pair.
entries.irish: A geata mhaisiúil agus sturdy. Le húsáid aige féin nó mar chuid de péire.

entries.english: Intricate designs run along this support structure.
entries.irish: Riarann dearaí diana feadh an struchtúir tacaíochta seo.

entries.english: The ravens are trusted companions of the Allfather, of course you would want one in your home as well.
entries.irish: Is iad na ravens companions iontaofa an Allfather, ar ndóigh, ba mhaith leat ceann i do theach chomh maith.

entries.english: This shallow roof is sure to keep the rain out, and look good doing it.
entries.irish: Tá an díon éadomhain cinnte a choinneáil ar an báisteach amach, agus breathnú maith ag déanamh é.

entries.english: This steeper roof is sure to keep the rain out, and look good doing it.
entries.irish: Is é seo an díon níos géire cinnte a choinneáil ar an báisteach amach, agus breathnú maith ag déanamh air.

entries.english: This very steep roof is sure to keep the rain out, and look good doing it.
entries.irish: Tá an díon an-ghéar cinnte a choinneáil ar an báisteach amach, agus breathnú maith ag déanamh é.

entries.english: Wolves are pack animals, but this one seems happy enough by itself.
entries.irish: Tá Wolves ainmhithe pacáiste, ach is cosúil an ceann seo sásta go leor aige féin.

entries.english: This wall won't do much to keep out the cold, but it's very pretty to look at.
entries.irish: Ní bheidh an bhalla a dhéanamh i bhfad a choinneáil amach an fuar, ach tá sé an-go leor chun breathnú ar.

entries.english: Both a bridge and a gate, how clever!
entries.irish: An dá droichead agus geata, cé chomh cliste!

entries.english: Convenient for crossing chasms, or for keeping enemies out.
entries.irish: Áisiúil do chasms trasnú, nó do naimhde a choinneáil amach.

entries.english: A finely wrought lantern, crafted by a true artisan. The wall mount is easy enough to figure out though!
entries.irish: A laindéir fíneáil wrought, crafted ag ceardaí fíor. Is é an mount balla éasca go leor chun an figiúr amach cé!

entries.english: You can build a pole easy enough, but the lantern can only have been made by a true master.
entries.irish: Is féidir leat a thógáil cuaille éasca go leor, ach is féidir leis an laindéir a bheith déanta ach ag máistir fíor.

entries.english: Dvergr design is all the rage these days.
entries.irish: Tá dearadh Dvergr go léir an rage na laethanta.

entries.english: The dvergr know how to keep unwanted visitors away.
entries.irish: Tá a fhios ag an dvergr conas cuairteoirí nach dteastaíonn a choinneáil ar shiúl.

entries.english: Reinforced with metal, this is sure to be a sturdy defence.
entries.irish: Treisithe le miotail, tá sé seo cinnte a bheith ina chosaint sturdy.

entries.english: This machine will turn soft tissue into the magical substance eitr. The process is quite volatile, however, so stand back!
entries.irish: Cuirfidh an meaisín seo fíochán bog isteach san eitéar substainte draíochta. Tá an próiseas so-ghalaithe go leor, áfach, mar sin seasamh ar ais!

entries.english: His rage and regret are at war with each other, and their struggle will fuel this fire until the very end.
entries.irish: Tá a rage agus aiféala ag cogadh lena chéile, agus beidh a streachailt breosla an tine go dtí an deireadh an-.

entries.english: Lends a gentle light to your festivities.
entries.irish: Lends solas milis le do festivities.

entries.english: Mead needs to sit and ferment for a while, for all its intended properties to emerge.
entries.irish: Ní mór don mhoth suí agus coipeadh ar feadh tamaill, as a chuid maoine beartaithe go léir chun teacht chun cinn.

entries.english: Useful for cooking, warmth, or just resting for a bit.
entries.irish: Úsáideacha le haghaidh cócaireachta, teas, nó díreach resting le haghaidh beagán.

entries.english: If you don't want to place a campfire directly onto the ground, this is a classy alternative.
entries.irish: Más rud é nach bhfuil tú ag iarraidh a chur ar campfire díreach ar an talamh, tá sé seo ina rogha malartach classy.

entries.english: The heat is practically radiating from this stack...
entries.irish: Is é an teas radiating praiticiúil as an chairn...

entries.english: An impressive way to welcome your friends, or to ward off your foes.
entries.irish: Bealach iontach chun fáilte a chur roimh do chairde, nó chun bharda as do foes.

entries.english: When you want to work with metal, you need a forge.
entries.irish: Nuair is mian leat a bheith ag obair le miotail, is gá duit a chruthú.

entries.english: Pressing down on these bellows generates more heat, which is very helpful for smithing.
entries.irish: Ag brú síos ar na bellows Gineann teas níos mó, atá an-chabhrach do smithing.

entries.english: For more detailed work, multiple kinds of anvils can come in handy.
entries.irish: Le haghaidh obair níos mionsonraithe, is féidir le cineálacha éagsúla anvils teacht i handy.

entries.english: A grinding wheel is necessary for sharpening any kind of sword.
entries.irish: Tá roth meilt is gá chun géarú aon chineál claíomh.

entries.english: A large anvil for working large items. Make sure it doesn't fall on your feet.
entries.irish: A anvil mór le haghaidh obair míreanna móra. Bí cinnte nach dtagann sé ar do chosa.

entries.english: Once a creation is done, this barrel of water will bring the metal down to a manageable temperature.
entries.irish: Chomh luath agus a chruthú a dhéanamh, beidh an bairille uisce a thabhairt ar an miotail síos go dtí teocht inbhainistithe.

entries.english: You need lots of different tools to work with. These conveniently come with a rack for storage.
entries.irish: Ní mór duit go leor de na huirlisí éagsúla a bheith ag obair leis. Na teacht go caothúil le raca le haghaidh stórála.

entries.english: This foundry can be used to harden casts into proper items.
entries.irish: Is féidir an teilgean seo a úsáid chun teilgin a chruachadh i míreanna cuí.

entries.english: A strange and chilling process happens within this kiln, to produce a most potent fuel...
entries.irish: Tarlaíonn próiseas aisteach agus fuaraithe laistigh den kiln seo, chun breosla is potent a tháirgeadh...

entries.english: These thin floor tiles are deceptively sturdy.
entries.irish: Tá na tíleanna urláir tanaí deceptively sturdy.

entries.english: Strong enough to withstand a land of fire.
entries.irish: Láidir go leor chun talamh tine a sheasamh.

entries.english: A roof design fit for the mightiest of halls.
entries.irish: A oiriúnach dearadh díon don mightiest de hallaí.

entries.english: Just take one step after the other.
entries.irish: Just a ghlacadh céim amháin tar éis an ceann eile.

entries.english: Good for getting to higher levels.
entries.irish: Dea chun dul go dtí leibhéil níos airde.

entries.english: Stone walls inspired by a long-gone civilisation.
entries.irish: Ballaí cloiche spreagtha ag sibhialtacht fhada.

entries.english: Grausten, carefully placed into a pile.
entries.irish: Grausten, a chur go cúramach isteach i carn.

entries.english: A sturdy iron torch to light up your surroundings.
entries.irish: A torch iarainn sturdy chun solais suas do thimpeallacht.

entries.english: A sturdy iron torch, emitting an eerie blue light.
entries.irish: A torch iarainn sturdy, astú solas gorm eerie.

entries.english: Bind the wisp to a fixed spot, to ensure the place is always free of mist.
entries.irish: Ceangail an wisp ar an láthair seasta, chun a chinntiú go bhfuil an áit i gcónaí saor ó olc.

entries.english: A sturdy iron torch, burning with a green flame.
entries.irish: A torch iarainn sturdy, dhó le lasair glas.

entries.english: A torch to stick in the ground, for when you need your hands free.
entries.irish: A torch a bata sa talamh, le haghaidh nuair is gá duit do lámha saor in aisce.

entries.english: Emits a magic seal on the nearby surroundings which prevents other players from constructing buildings or opening doors.
entries.irish: Emits séala draíochta ar an timpeallacht in aice láimhe a chuireann cosc ar imreoirí eile ó thógáil foirgnimh nó doirse a oscailt.

entries.english: Blue jute makes any building look official and important.
entries.irish: Déanann jute gorm aon fhoirgneamh cuma oifigiúil agus tábhachtach.

entries.english: A central part of any homestead.
This dwarven design is excellent for keeping unwanted guests out.
entries.irish: Tá an dearadh dwarven den scoth le haghaidh aíonna nach dteastaíonn a choinneáil amach.

entries.english: Aimed in just one direction, the light grows more potent. Convenient for sneak thieves, or those who wish to leave a trail.
entries.irish: Aimed i díreach treo amháin, fásann an solas níos potent. Áisiúil do thieves sneak, nó iad siúd ar mian leo a fhágáil rian.

entries.english: Thor bestows a gift upon you!
If you have iron, you have everything.
entries.irish: Má tá tú iarainn, tá gach rud agat.

entries.english: Finely crafted iron bars, sure to be rattle-proof!
entries.irish: barraí iarainn crafted Finely, cinnte a bheith ramhar-cruthúnas!
Ní féidir leat an mhír seo a cheangal

entries.english: Place items on horizontal surfaces with this item stand.
entries.irish: Cuir míreanna ar dhromchlaí cothrománacha leis an seastán mír seo.

entries.english: Mount items on vertical surfaces with this item stand.
entries.irish: Míreanna Mount ar dhromchlaí ingearach leis an seastán mír.

entries.english: The face carved into this vegetable...is it spooky or friendly?
entries.irish: An aghaidh snoite isteach sa glasraí...is spooky nó cairdiúil é?

entries.english: This coarse fabric is excellent for keeping the cold at bay.
entries.irish: Tá an creatlach garbh seo den scoth chun an fuar a choinneáil ag bá.

entries.english: No matter how misty the air is, this carpet doesn't appear to get damp.
entries.irish: Is cuma cé chomh olc go bhfuil an t-aer, nach bhfuil an cairpéad dealraitheach a fháil taise.

entries.english: If the terrain is too lumpy, you can just flatten it.
entries.irish: Má tá an tír-raon ró-chnapánach, is féidir leat é a leacú.

entries.english: Mysterious galdr forces gather upon this altar. It's up to you to harness them...
entries.irish: fórsaí réaltra mistéireach bhailiú ar an altóir. Tá sé suas chun tú chun leas a bhaint astu...

entries.english: These candles emit a strange light, urging more potent magic to coalesce around them.
entries.irish: Na coinnle astaíonn solas aisteach, lorg draíochta níos potent a coalesce timpeall orthu.

entries.english: An offering to the mysterious powers scattered across the realms. Perhaps they will lend themselves to you.
entries.irish: tairiscint do na cumhachtaí mistéireach scaipthe ar fud na realms. B'fhéidir go mbeidh siad ar iasacht iad féin a thabhairt duit.

entries.english: The Norns weave the threads of fate together in a magical tapestry. What shall you weave?
entries.irish: Na Norns weave na snáitheanna de cinniúint le chéile i téipeanna draíochta. Cad a fhífidh tú?

entries.english: Runes are a well-known tool for channeling magic, if one knows how to read them.
entries.irish: Tá Runes uirlis-aitheanta go maith le haghaidh draíocht cainéalú, má tá a fhios ag duine conas iad a léamh.

entries.english: On the longest day of the year, let this monument stretch towards the sun!
entries.irish: Ar an lá is faide den bhliain, lig an séadchomhartha síneadh i dtreo an ghrian!

entries.english: This copper pot holds the perfect temperature for mixing mead.
entries.irish: Tá an pota copair an teocht foirfe do mead mheascadh.

entries.english: You can't help but to feel like there's something romantic about this...
entries.irish: Ní féidir leat cabhrú ach a bhraitheann cosúil go bhfuil rud éigin rómánsúil mar gheall ar seo...
Amharc ar ár liosta iomlán de shuíomhanna

entries.english: Though rustic and sturdy, this throne is well suited even for the most noble of royalty.
entries.irish: Cé rustic agus sturdy, tá an ríchathaoir oiriúnach go maith fiú don chuid is mó uasal de ríchíosa.

entries.english: A pile as dark as the night itself.
entries.irish: A carn chomh dorcha mar an oíche féin.
I gcás gach do riachtanais bácála.

entries.english: Mark out the best way forward.
entries.irish: Marcáil amach an bealach is fearr ar aghaidh.
Riachtanais seomra níos mó ag fás
Ní féidir fás sa timpeallacht seo

entries.english: Censored words found, potential crossplay issue.
entries.irish: Focail chinsithe le fáil, eisiúint tras-imirt féideartha.

entries.english: Connects to another portal with equal or no tag.
entries.irish: Ceangail le tairseach eile le clib comhionann nó gan aon.

entries.english: The powerful energy source lets you pass through even with the most valuable of items.
entries.irish: Ligeann an fhoinse fuinnimh cumhachtach duit pas a fháil trí fiú leis an chuid is mó luachmhar na n-ítimí.

entries.english: A large statement piece of a pot! You could almost fit an entire viking in there.
entries.irish: Tá píosa ráiteas mór de phota! D'fhéadfá a d'oirfeadh beagnach inmharthana ar fad ann.

entries.english: A piece of ceramic, deep enough to fit a thing or two inside.
entries.irish: Tá píosa ceirmeach, domhain go leor a d'oirfeadh rud nó dhá taobh istigh.

entries.english: A small piece of earthenware, with room for something inside.
entries.irish: Tá píosa beag de cré-earraí, le seomra le haghaidh rud éigin taobh istigh.

entries.english: Not everything can be poured directly into the cauldron, so you need a good surface to work on!
entries.irish: Ní féidir gach rud a dhoirteadh go díreach isteach sa chauldron, mar sin ní mór duit dromchla maith a bheith ag obair ar!

entries.english: Fill holes and create elevated platforms.
entries.irish: Poill líonadh agus ardáin ardaithe a chruthú.

entries.english: Restore the ground to its original vegetation.
entries.irish: Athchóirigh an talamh ar a fásra bunaidh.

entries.english: Adds a rustic touch to any garden.
entries.irish: Cuireann sé teagmháil rustic le haon ghairdín.

entries.english: With how lumpy asksvin hide is, it's hard to make anything useful from a single piece. Some assembly is required.
entries.irish: Leis an gcaoi a n-iarrann lumpy i bhfolach, tá sé deacair rud ar bith a dhéanamh úsáideach ó phíosa amháin. Tá roinnt tionól ag teastáil.

entries.english: The fur is soft, though the teeth are still sharp.
entries.irish: Is é an fionnaidh bog, cé go bhfuil na fiacla fós géar.

entries.english: Protects your feet from wood splinters.
entries.irish: Cosain do chosa ó splinters adhmaid.

entries.english: It's a strange texture, but a very interesting piece of decor.
entries.irish: Is uigeacht aisteach é, ach píosa maisiú an-suimiúil.
Tá sé thar a bheith fluffy!

entries.english: This carpet is neatly sewn together, to ensure a large, soft surface.
entries.irish: Tá an cairpéad sewn go néata le chéile, chun dromchla mór, bog a chinntiú.

entries.english: This rug is so soft, soft like innocence.
entries.irish: Tá an rug chomh bog, bog cosúil le innocence.

entries.english: Warm and cosy, especially up in the mountains.
entries.irish: Te agus Cosy, go háirithe suas sna sléibhte.
Ní dhéanfaidh aon ní a bhaint

entries.english: A robust grain that can be ground into flour.
entries.irish: Grán láidir is féidir a bheith ina phlúr.

entries.english: Plant carrot seeds to grow carrots
entries.irish: Síolta cairéad plandaí ag fás cairéid

entries.english: Pretty flowers with fibres that can be spun into thread.
entries.irish: Bláthanna roimh le snáithíní is féidir a spun isteach sa snáithe.
Úsáideacha le haghaidh oidis cócaireachta go leor.

entries.english: Plant a carrot to get more seeds
entries.irish: Plandaí cairéad chun níos mó síolta a fháil

entries.english: Plant kale seeds to get even more seeds.
entries.irish: Síolta plandaí a fháil síolta níos mó.

entries.english: Plant an onion to get more seeds.
entries.irish: Plandaí oinniún chun níos mó síolta a fháil.

entries.english: Plant a turnip to get more seeds
entries.irish: Gléasra torna a fháil síolta níos mó

entries.english: A hearty vegetable used for cooking.
entries.irish: A glasraí hearty a úsáidtear le haghaidh cócaireachta.
Riachtanais rud éigin a cling go.
Riachtanais rud éigin a cling go.

entries.english: The overlapping wood of these walls provide excellent protection against the elements.
entries.irish: Soláthraíonn adhmad forluí de na ballaí seo cosaint den scoth i gcoinne na n-eilimintí.

entries.english: Why stick a torch in the ground when you can hang it on your wall?
entries.irish: Cén fáth bata torch sa talamh nuair is féidir leat é a chrochadh ar do bhalla?

entries.english: If someone comes too close, they'll get poked.
entries.irish: Má thagann duine éigin ró-dlúth, beidh siad poked.

entries.english: Creates a shield to protect against weather and incoming projectiles. Fuelled by bones of any kind.
entries.irish: Cruthaigh sciath a chosaint i gcoinne aimsir agus diúracáin ag teacht isteach. Breosla ag cnámha d'aon chineál.

entries.english: Disorder is a survivalist's worst enemy. Defend yourself against it by putting up signs.
entries.irish: Is disorder namhaid is measa marthanóir. Cosain tú féin ina choinne trí comharthaí a chur suas.

entries.english: A tidy way of displaying your wealth.
entries.irish: Bealach slachtmhar a thaispeáint do saibhreas.

entries.english: A certain proof of your prowess in combat.
entries.irish: A cruthúnas áirithe de do prowess i chomhrac.

entries.english: Fuel and ore go in, beautiful metal ingots come out.
entries.irish: Breosla agus ore dul i, ingots miotail álainn teacht amach.

entries.english: Adds a cosy touch to a wintry landscape.
entries.irish: Cuireann teagmháil chosy le tírdhreach wintry.

entries.english: This automated machine makes spinning fibres into thread a remarkably quick process.
entries.irish: Déanann an meaisín uathoibrithe snáithíní sníomh isteach snáithe próiseas thar cuimse tapaidh.
Dea chun intruders a choinneáil amach.

entries.english: These supports add a tasteful and decorative touch.
entries.irish: Cuireann na tacaíochtaí seo teagmháil tasteful agus maisiúil.

entries.english: Heavy timber walls are good for keeping out the cold.
entries.irish: Tá ballaí adhmaid trom maith chun an fuar a choinneáil amach.

entries.english: These thick chunks of wood are sure to support your constructions.
entries.irish: Tá na smutáin tiubh adhmaid cinnte chun tacú le do tógálacha.

entries.english: Not quite as glorious as the gates of Valhalla, but awfully close!
entries.irish: Ní leor mar glorious mar na geataí Valhalla, ach awfully gar!

entries.english: If you want to build with stone, you'll need a stonecutter to work the material.
entries.irish: Más mian leat a thógáil le cloch, beidh ort stonecutter chun an t-ábhar a oibriú.

entries.english: Stones carefully pieced together into a sturdy fence.
entries.irish: Clocha le chéile go cúramach i fál sturdy.

entries.english: Best to put a rug on it, or it might get cold!
entries.irish: Is fearr rug a chur air, nó d'fhéadfadh sé fuar a fháil!

entries.english: It's a big pile of stone.
entries.irish: Tá sé ina carn mór de chloch.

entries.english: Useful for getting around in a large fortress.
entries.irish: Úsáideacha chun dul timpeall i fortress mór.

entries.english: A good leader must be firm like stone, yet they also need to know when to be soft like furs...
entries.irish: Ní mór do cheannaire maith a bheith daingean cosúil le cloch, ach ní mór dóibh freisin a fhios nuair a bheith bog cosúil le fionnaidh...

entries.english: A roughly hewn block of stone.
entries.irish: A bloc garbh hewn de chloch.

entries.english: This table is perfect for a large feast, with room for many different dishes!
entries.irish: Tá an tábla seo foirfe le haghaidh féasta mór, le seomra le haghaidh go leor miasa éagsúla!

entries.english: At a round table, no seat is more important than any other.
entries.irish: Ag bord cruinn, níl aon suíochán níos tábhachtaí ná aon cheann eile.

entries.english: The story carved into this table is excellent to read during long feasts.
entries.irish: Is é an scéal snoite isteach sa tábla seo den scoth a léamh le linn féastaí fada.

entries.english: A table for more intimate gatherings.
entries.irish: Tá tábla le haghaidh cruinnithe níos pearsanta.

entries.english: Perhaps this is what Odin's throne in Valhalla looks like... Either way, it's comfortable!
entries.irish: B'fhéidir gurb é seo an méid a Breathnaíonn ríchathaoir Odin i Valhalla cosúil le... Ceachtar slí, tá sé compordach!

entries.english: You can make a lot of bronze with this...
entries.irish: Is féidir leat a lán cré-umha a dhéanamh leis seo...

entries.english: Step close at your own risk!
entries.irish: Céim gar ar do riosca féin!
Níl an Trap réidh go fóill

entries.english: This trap will clamp down on whatever steps on it. Careful!
entries.irish: Beidh an gaiste clamp síos ar cibé céimeanna ar sé. Cúramach!

entries.english: A small fortune, gleaming and glittering.
entries.irish: A fortune beag, gleaming agus glittering.

entries.english: It's important to keep count of your coins.
entries.irish: Tá sé tábhachtach a choinneáil ar chomhaireamh de do boinn.

entries.english: Defensive structure that shoots missiles at anything that gets in its way.
entries.irish: Struchtúr cosanta go diúracáin shoots ag aon rud a fhaigheann ar a bhealach.
Níl an Tweet seo ar fáil

entries.english: Turns grain into flour. Works best on windy days!
entries.irish: Casann gráin isteach i plúr. Oibríonn sé is fearr ar laethanta na gaoithe!

entries.english: Attracts wisps. They mostly come at night... mostly.
entries.irish: Caitheamh aimsire. Tagann siad den chuid is mó san oíche... den chuid is mó.

entries.english: The wisps want more open space
entries.irish: An wisps ag iarraidh spás níos oscailte

entries.english: A big pile of logs, fresh from the forest.
entries.irish: A carn mór de logs, úr ó na foraoise.

entries.english: A simple door for opening and closing.
entries.irish: Doras simplí le haghaidh oscailt agus dúnadh.

entries.english: Make your home legendary by decorating it with a dragon.
entries.irish: Déan do bhaile legendary ag maisiú sé le Dragon.

entries.english: A good fence, for livestock and crops alike!
entries.irish: Fál maith, le haghaidh beostoic agus barra araon!

entries.english: A gate is far more practical than jumping over the fence every time.
entries.irish: Tá geata i bhfad níos praiticiúla ná léim thar an fál gach uair.

entries.english: This pile of wood is waiting to be turned into furniture.
entries.irish: Tá an carn adhmaid ag fanacht le iompú isteach i troscán.

entries.english: A solid bit of wooden flooring.
entries.irish: Tá beagán soladach de flooring adhmaid.

entries.english: It's as if fresh snow just fell upon it...
entries.irish: Tá sé mar má thit sneachta úr díreach air...

entries.english: A simple wooden gate. To use by itself or as part of a pair.
entries.irish: A geata adhmaid simplí. Le húsáid aige féin nó mar chuid de péire.

entries.english: The strongest support you've ever built.
entries.irish: An tacaíocht is láidre atá tógtha agat riamh.

entries.english: Support your constructions in this rustic style.
entries.irish: Tacaíocht do tógálacha sa stíl rustic.

entries.english: A simple roof to keep the rain out, built at a shallow angle.
entries.irish: Tá díon simplí a choinneáil ar an bháisteach amach, tógtha ag uillinn éadomhain.

entries.english: A simple roof to keep the rain out, with a steeper angle.
entries.irish: Tá díon simplí a choinneáil ar an bháisteach amach, le uillinn níos géire.

entries.english: A simple roof to keep the rain out, built at a very steep angle.
entries.irish: Tá díon simplí a choinneáil ar an bháisteach amach, tógtha ag uillinn an-ghéar.

entries.english: Put all that hard work on display!
entries.irish: Cuir go léir go obair chrua ar taispeáint!

entries.english: Good for getting off the ground.
entries.irish: Dea chun dul as an talamh.
áisiúil le haghaidh dreapadóireachta níos airde.

entries.english: Walls are an important part of any house!
entries.irish: Tá ballaí mar chuid thábhachtach d'aon teach!

entries.english: Open or closed, keep it the way you prefer or switch things up whenever you feel like it!
entries.irish: Oscailte nó dúnta, é a choinneáil ar an mbealach is fearr leat nó rudaí a athrú suas aon uair a bhraitheann tú mhaith é!

entries.english: A workbench is necessary for any home. You need it to build wooden structures and craft new tools.
entries.irish: Tá gá le binse oibre le haghaidh aon bhaile. Ní mór duit é a thógáil struchtúir adhmaid agus uirlisí nua ceardaíochta.

entries.english: An axe is a very versatile tool for crafting.
entries.irish: Is axe uirlis an-versatile le haghaidh crafting.

entries.english: Leathers and hides need proper treatment before they can be used.
entries.irish: Ní mór cóireáil chuí a bheith ag leathar agus ag seithí sula bhféadfar iad a úsáid.

entries.english: Sometimes you need to work the problem from a different angle.
entries.irish: Uaireanta is gá duit a bheith ag obair ar an bhfadhb ó uillinn éagsúla.

entries.english: Fine detail work requires fine tools to match.
entries.irish: Éilíonn obair mion Fine uirlisí fíneáil a mheaitseáil.

entries.english: Fine branches, thrumming with mysterious energy.
entries.irish: brainsí fíneáil, ag dul le fuinneamh mistéireach.

entries.english: It's hard to think of anything more festive than a wreath!
entries.irish: Tá sé deacair smaoineamh ar rud ar bith níos féile ná fleasc!

entries.english: A small gift for someone you like.
entries.irish: Tá bronntanas beag do dhuine is mian leat.

entries.english: A gift for someone who was nice this year.
entries.irish: Tá bronntanas do dhuine a bhí deas i mbliana.

entries.english: A large gift for someone you appreciate a lot.
entries.irish: Tá bronntanas mór do dhuine meas tú a lán.

entries.english: This fir tree has been given festive decorative lights.
entries.irish: Tá an crann lámhaigh tugtha soilse maisiúil Fhéile.
